title.en: The web app takes shape: files, upload, preview, download, trash, sharing
title.zh: 网页应用成形：文件、上传、预览、下载、回收站、分享

summary.en: Six pieces of the web app were built and checked in a real browser against the real backend: the file browser (R-007), upload with progress, cancel and folders (R-008), preview with gallery, audio and video (R-009), batch download as ZIP or tar.gz (R-010), trash, sharing and storage usage (R-011). A backend bug that rejected every upload over 2 MB was found by the upload work and fixed (B-003). After merging everything: web app build, lint and 81 tests pass; Rust clippy clean, 156 + 30 + 12 + 7 tests pass. In progress: account settings (R-012) and the admin/update page with the reload-after-update behaviour (R-013, R-027). Not done: a download test in non-Chromium browsers, a 400 MB upload test, and the Shared-with-me folder view. A-004 (cloud icon C or D) still waits for you.
summary.zh: 网页应用的六个部分已建成，并在真实浏览器中对真实后端检查过：文件浏览（R-007）、带进度/取消/文件夹的上传（R-008）、带图集与音视频的预览（R-009）、ZIP 或 tar.gz 批量下载（R-010）、回收站、分享与存储用量（R-011）。上传开发中发现并修复了后端的一个缺陷：超过 2 MB 的上传全部被拒绝（B-003）。全部合并后：网页应用构建、静态检查与 81 项测试通过；Rust clippy 无警告，156 + 30 + 12 + 7 项测试通过。进行中：账户设置（R-012）、管理/更新页与更新后自动刷新（R-013、R-027）。未完成：非 Chromium 浏览器的下载测试、400 MB 上传测试、「与我共享」的文件夹浏览。A-004（云图标 C 或 D）仍等你决定。

bullets.en: **R-007, R-008, R-009, R-010, R-011 (review):** built and exercised in a real browser; screenshots below.
bullets.zh: **R-007、R-008、R-009、R-010、R-011（待验收）：**已建成并在真实浏览器中操作过；截图见下。

bullets.en: **B-003 (fixed):** uploads over 2 MB returned 400; now only `MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_MB` applies and an over-limit upload gets a JSON 413. New integration test.
bullets.zh: **B-003（已修复）：**超过 2 MB 的上传返回 400；现在只受 `MAX_UPLOAD_SIZE_MB` 限制，超限返回 JSON 413。新增集成测试。

bullets.en: Merge fixes I made: duplicate error keys in the language files and two copies of the single-file download helper were removed.
bullets.zh: 合并时我修掉的问题：语言文件中重复的错误键，以及两份重复的单文件下载函数。
